claims.evidence: The witness identified a game console but did not confirm the model name or see a model sticker.
The UK receipt mentioned by the seller is not shown in the photos.
There are no photos or clips of the console powered on or connected to a display.
The warranty seals on the rear of the console are not shown or are obscured.
Thermal performance cannot be determined from static photos.
Ports are visible but their functionality is not demonstrated.
Only one controller was seen by the witness; its authenticity as an 'original' Sony product is not confirmed.

risks.risk: Storage capacity could be the minimum (500GB) rather than 1TB.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage Management' screen in the settings.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty or unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video showing a game disc being inserted, recognized by the system, and ejected.
risks.if_unproven: as a digital-only console with a broken drive.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the console successfully logged into the PlayStation Store.

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may be hiding significant scratches, cracks, or heat damage on the casing.
risks.proof: Photos of the console from all angles with the plastic wrap removed.

risks.risk: The controller may have 'stick drift' or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the menu or a controller test app.
risks.if_unproven: as a faulty controller needing replacement.

proof_requests: Photo of the model number sticker (usually on the back or bottom).
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned.
Video of the console powered on and showing the system information screen.
Photo of the warranty seal (void if removed) to confirm it hasn't been opened.
Photos of the console without the plastic wrap.
response.reason: The specific model and storage capacity are unconfirmed, and the plastic wrap prevents a proper assessment of the physical condition and whether the unit has been opened for repair.
